import boto3

def publish_to_sns(client):
    return client.publish(
        TopicArn="arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:000:order-events",
        Message="hi",
    )

def send_to_sqs(client):
    return client.send_message(
        QueueUrl="https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/orders-queue",
        MessageBody="v",
    )

def receive_from_sqs(client):
    return client.receive_message(
        QueueUrl="https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/audit-queue",
    )
